tables.name: bpay_next_case_pause_outcome

constraints.name: bpay_next_case_pause_outcome_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((((outcome = 'APPLIED'::text) AND (issue_code IS NULL) AND (applied_case_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (applied_case_revision > 0) AND (applied_status IS NOT NULL) AND (applied_status =
CASE action
    WHEN 'CASE_PAUSE'::text THEN 'PAUSED'::text
    ELSE 'OPEN'::text
END)) OR ((outcome = 'BLOCKED'::text) AND (applied_status IS NULL) AND (applied_case_revision IS NULL) AND (issue_code IS NOT NULL) AND (issue_code = ANY (ARRAY['BPAY_NEXT_CASE_PROTECTION_CHANGED'::text, 'BPAY_NEXT_CASE_PAUSE_UNSUPPORTED'::text, 'BPAY_NEXT_CASE_PAUSE_STATE_CHANGED'::text, 'BPAY_NEXT_CASE_PROTECTION_PENDING'::text, 'BPAY_NEXT_CASE_PROTECTED_SLICE'::text, 'BPAY_NEXT_CASE_PROTECTION_BALANCE_INVALID'::text])))))

constraints.name: bpay_next_case_pause_outcome_command_id_candidate_id_actio_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (command_id, candidate_id, action) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_job(command_id, candidate_id, job_kind) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: bpay_next_case_pause_outcome_command_id_case_id_candidate__fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (command_id, case_id, candidate_id, action) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_case_pause_request(command_id, case_id, candidate_id, action) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: bpay_next_case_pause_outcome_job_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_job(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CREATE TRIGGER bpay_next_case_pause_outcome_truncate_v1 BEFORE TRUNCATE ON private.bpay_next_case_pause_outcome FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.bpay_next_effect_immutable_v1()

constraints.name: bpay_next_case_pause_request_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((action = 'CASE_PAUSE'::text) AND (prior_status = 'OPEN'::text) AND (target_status = 'PAUSED'::text)) OR ((action = 'CASE_RESUME'::text) AND (prior_status = 'PAUSED'::text) AND (target_status = 'OPEN'::text))))
